source.license: CC0 as stated by the original Figshare record

signal.reference: common average across the 14 EEG channels
signal.filter: causal Butterworth N=4 bandpass applied continuously within each run, with zero initial state
signal.features: log of summed Welch density bins, lower boundary inclusive and upper boundary exclusive; floor 1e-10 in squared microvolt units

labels.rest_requirement: complete interval lies within the recording and ends no later than one second before the next cue
labels.training_requirement: entire trailing window lies within one eligible left, right or idle interval
labels.other_time: transitions, preparation, uncovered time and incomplete eligible intervals are unknown
labels.interval_semantics: half open; command time is the end of its available input window

model.rest_gate_scores: movement probabilities multiplied by task probability; these are decision scores, not calibrated joint probabilities

policy.selection: for each condition, select on pooled validation runs the highest fraction of cues whose first command is correct among policies with at most one idle command per minute; ties choose lower idle command rate, higher enter threshold, then longer hold
policy.fallback_rule: use the fallback when no candidate meets both target requirements; report target failure

evaluation.interpretation: same participants on a later session, four experienced healthy volunteers, protocol inferred rest, recorded replay only
